data.body: Implementation landed for review: Gerrit change 1285 (commit 72f1a97f18, stacked on f1eb's 1275). TDD trail: oracle tests/unit/metrics/test_bug_trends.py (6 tests, happy-path contract incl. MISSING labeled cohort, clock seam, descending fan-in, registry ids/labels) + held-out test_bug_trends_heldout.py (15 tests: zero-bug/missing-tracker unavailability, non-bug exclusion, detected_by sibling-degradation independence, all-MISSING month, flow-vs-stock range semantics, single-sample percentiles, in_progress counts as open, unresolved caused_by target counted, UNLINK removal, registry evaluate Unavailable/MetricValue labels, CLI end-to-end fault-isolation rendering). RED confirmed (ModuleNotFoundError) before implementation. Subagent implemented to oracle only; orchestrator refactored (extracted pure _derive_* over rows, wired real ctx.analysis_cache sharing — subagent's cache path was dead code — hoisted datetime import). Held-out first exposure: 21/21 green. Mutation checks: 5/5 killed (drop-MISSING, ignore-range, floor-rank percentile, closed-leak open-age, ascending fan-in). tests/unit/metrics 109 passed; lint+mypy clean. Real-store smoke: close_class months incl. MISSING cohort for pre-convention July, ttc count=228, open age count=32, detected_by honestly unavailable (no bug carries d3ed field yet), fan-in descending. Awaiting LLM-Review + Verified on 1285.
